caption: The drawing is vertically oriented and rendered in grayscale, using shades of gray, black, and white. The main central figure is a woman with long flowing hair, dressed in a draped, classical-style gown. She is seated on a rocky outcrop, with one foot extended downward and her left arm resting on her lap, while her right arm supports her on the rock. Above her, an angelic figure with wings, wearing a robe and holding a harp or lyre, is depicted amidst clouds, looking towards the seated woman. Below the woman, at the bottom foreground of the drawing, are fragments of architectural elements, including a broken column and a scroll, partially submerged in water. The background consists of a cloudy, tumultuous sky rendered in various shades of gray. The drawing’s border is surrounded by a plain, off-white margin. There is a handwritten caption at the bottom, reading "PSYCHE ABANDONNÉE en I. 163," along with the artist’s signature.
title: Wall Paper
